summary: Too easy for Today's list: the top 10 is nearly the ten countries everyone names, so a casual player finds 9 or 10. A great Blitz, and the misses (Italy #26, UK #19) are the fun part.
reasons: Casual found 9 (out of lives on Italy, UK, Canada, Sweden, Russia); a brand-led casual order found all 10 with a life left. The crowd average lands about 6.4 to 6.7, over the 5 to 6 target.
Curve is flat: China, US, Japan, Germany and South Korea are gimmes, India, Mexico, France and Brazil come next, and Spain is the only stretch. No answer surprises once revealed.

Too close in kind to car-makers (Nov 24) and car-models (Dec 2) for the week of Dec 7-13: a third car list in under three weeks, and car-makers' top 10 (Toyota, VW, Hyundai, GM, BYD) is a map of this one.

Data matches Wikipedia's 2025 column exactly. #10 to #12 are close (France 1,463,991, Thailand 1,455,569, Czech Republic 1,452,776) but not tied. Every top-10 fact is sourced, and every casual miss shows its rank and figure.
Blitz: 21 of 23 quick names scored. Only Australia and Vietnam missed, having no 2025 figure.
fixes: Sent to free play: drop `debut: true` from car-countries in scripts/topics.ts, or it waits out of random play for good.
"car" (and "c.a.r.") matches Central African Republic through its "C.A.R." alias and costs a life, with no figure, on a car list. Drop that alias on this topic, or make the subject word free.
Dissolved states cost a life with no figure on a 2025 ranking: Soviet Union ("ussr"), East Germany, Czechoslovakia, Yugoslavia. Make them free, as West Germany already is.
